material_type: The aim of this study was to corroborate the content of products for diagnosis and treatment of dust mite allergies that are produced and sold in India.

disease_state.evidence: Skin prick test (SPT) solutions and allergy vaccines (AVs) are crucial tools for diagnosis and therapy of allergies.

sample_source.evidence: All samples were purchased by collaborating physicians in India from local vendors and shipped to Europe under temperature-controlled conditions at 4 °C.

species.value: Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus, Dermatophagoides farinae, Suidasia medanensis, Cicer arietinum, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Homo sapiens
species.evidence: From the 5 Indian Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus products, none contained proteins from this source. Instead, 1 sample contained Dermatophagoides farinae and human serum proteins, 4 products contained allergens from the storage mite Suidasia medanensis, allergens from the legume Cicer arietinum (chickpea), and proteins from baker's yeast.
